# Matthias Endler

> Matthias Endler (also known as mre) is a Rust consultant, open-source maintainer, and founder of corrode Rust Consulting in Düsseldorf, Germany. He created the lychee link checker and hosts the Rust in Production podcast.

endler.dev is Matthias' personal website: essays on software engineering, Rust, open-source maintenance, and building a business. corrode is his consulting company and the home of his professional Rust guides, training, and services. This site provides the personal background and engineering perspective behind that work.

## Work with Matthias

- [Rust Consulting and Training](https://corrode.dev/services/): Code review, architecture, training, and migration support for teams adopting or already using Rust.
- [1-on-1 Rust Mentorship](https://corrode.dev/mentorship/): Work directly with Matthias on a real Rust project, developing both the code and the judgment to maintain it independently.
- [Why I Still Believe in Mentorship](https://endler.dev/2026/why-i-still-believe-in-mentorship/): His approach to mentorship, questioning assumptions, and helping experienced engineers grow.
- [corrode's llms.txt](https://corrode.dev/llms.txt): The companion directory for consulting services, migration guides, workshops, courses, and Rust resources.

## Profile

- [About Matthias Endler](https://endler.dev/about/): Biography, professional background, current projects, and contact details.

## Selected Writing

- [How to Review Code](https://endler.dev/2025/how-to-review-code/): Reviewing architecture, maintainability, and the problem being solved, not just syntax and style.
- [The Best Programmers I Know](https://endler.dev/2025/best-programmers/): Habits of effective engineers, from reading references to breaking down problems and helping others.
- [On Choosing Rust](https://endler.dev/2025/choosing-rust/): A personal response to objections about adopting Rust in established software.
- [Blog Archive](https://endler.dev/archive/): All posts, including older writing on Unix, programming tools, side projects, and open source.

## Open Source and Media

- [lychee](https://lychee.cli.rs/): A fast link checker written in Rust.
- [Analysis Tools](https://analysis-tools.dev/): A comparison platform for static and dynamic code analysis tools.
- [Idiomatic Rust](https://github.com/mre/idiomatic-rust): A curated collection of articles, talks, and repositories about writing idiomatic Rust.
- [Rust in Production](https://corrode.dev/podcast/): Matthias' interviews with engineers using Rust in production.
